description: Creates a PDF. HTTP calls can return a temporary download link. Configured customer sync can save contact details and a document summary and start follow-up. See https://pressmark.dev/privacy.

compliance_mode.description: Add a note for a selected compliance topic (none, eu_vat, peppol_bis, hipaa_baa). Does not certify compliance.

county.description: County name for jurats and headers.

currency_symbol_mode.description: Display currency symbol or ISO code.

doc_number.description: Document number supplied by the user. Left blank when omitted.

doc_type.description: Archetype slug (invoice, receipt, residential_lease, nda, etc.).

due_date.description: Payment due date (YYYY-MM-DD). Left blank when omitted.

execution_mode.description: Signature layout (esign, wet_ink, notarized_wet, ron). Does not sign or notarize the document.

issue_date.description: Issue date (YYYY-MM-DD). Left blank when omitted.

municipality.description: Municipal profile (Chicago, Cook County, NYC, SF, Seattle, Portland).

notary_required.description: Add a blank section for a notary to complete. Does not notarize the document.

payment_link.description: HTTPS checkout URL for QR code.

signatures.description: Signature fields using supplied names, dates, and optional signature images. A name alone leaves the signature line blank.

date.description: Signing date supplied by the user. Left blank when omitted.

signature_data.description: Optional supplied signature image as a Base64 data URI.

name: generate_document

doc_number.description: User-supplied document number, or an empty string when omitted.

download.description: Temporary file link when this tool is called over HTTP. Anyone with the URL can access the file until expiry or a service restart.

download_error.description: Why a temporary download link could not be created. The embedded PDF is still available.

title: Generate PDF Document
